scope: Proposition 6.3 (A conditional group permutation) of the manuscript “Conditional permutations in a revealed switching environment” (preprints/Conditional-permutations-in-a-revealed-switching-environment-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 59a17db01074b8bb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A ⊂ V have q = n/8 indices. Use k = 65536 phases, each consisting of 20d preparation layers without extra switches and one active sweep with extra switches on the pairs whose two base indices belong to A. Let κℬ be the law of the resulting multiplier on 𝔖(A) conditional on the full base shuffle ℬ. Then sup pre-call base histories 𝔼 [ ‖κℬ − UA‖TV | pre-call history ] −→ 0. The assertion is uniform in the starting cyclic phase and in the initial base placement. The multiplier law is independent of the incoming overlay permutation.
